title: A Stitched Third Birth
description: A one-minute stop-motion film made from approximately 720 frames, transforming everyday objects into a surreal creation story. Inspired by Frankenstein, Nezha, and Hundun, the work explores failure, reconstruction, rebirth, and ecological responsibility.

title: A-Z Tomato & Eggs
description: An A-to-Z cooking video built around tomato and scrambled eggs, one of the most familiar dishes in Chinese home cooking. Each letter corresponds to an action, ingredient, or object, combining food culture with a playful educational structure.

title: One Becomes Two
description: A 4-minute 44-second experimental narrative film in which different temporal versions of myself confront one another across past, present, and future. Through performance, colour, visual effects, and science-fiction imagery, the film explores fate, identity, adulthood, and the struggle to remain the author of one’s own future.
